name: moodle-ui-kit
description: A clean visual style for what your agent publishes in Moodle: assignment statements, code blocks, solutions, quiz questions and feedback, with inline styles that work on any Moodle site. Based on noeper's moodle-ui-kit.

description.es: Un estilo visual limpio para lo que tu agente publica en Moodle: enunciados de tareas, bloques de código, soluciones, preguntas de cuestionario y retroalimentación, con estilos en línea que funcionan en cualquier sitio Moodle. Basado en el moodle-ui-kit de noeper.

agent-kit.help: A visual style for Moodle, from moodle-ui-kit: my moodle-ui-kit:style-content skill fills its templates (an assignment's statement, code blocks, solutions, quiz questions and feedback) with inline styles, and publishes them with moodle-teacher.
